import pandas as pd
import os

# Define the paths
input_file = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
output_report_file = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
output_selected_file = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
output_dir = "outputs"
if not os.path.exists(output_dir):
    os.makedirs(output_dir)

# Read the input data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Calculate missingness per indicator
df['missing_count'] = df.isnull().sum()
df['missing_rate'] = df['missing_count'] / len(df)

# Keep indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
df_filtered = df[df['missing_rate'] <= 0.30]

# Write the missingness report
df_filtered.to_csv(output_report_file, index=False)

# Write the selected matrix
df_filtered[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator']].to_csv(output_selected_file, index=False)

print("Done. Output files created.")
</solution_file>
